purpose: C6 disk report before the HVFHV download (Stanley, Amendment 3)

disk.windows_c_note: C: free space fell by ~12 GiB within ~10 minutes while this session wrote only small result/figure files; cause outside the repo (Windows side or WSL virtual-disk growth), not identified

investigation_2026_11_12.finding: the 12 GiB drop was transient and not inside WSL: Linux root usage was 55 GiB at both df readings (before and after the drop), C: free recovered to 34 GiB without any deletion, and a 2-second probe of the DuckDB spill directories (data/warehouse.duckdb.tmp, data/duckdb_tmp), C: free and Linux usage during a full `make verify PHASE=4` (pytest + dbt test) showed no spill (<= 2 MB) and a C: change of 0.2 GiB (logs/spill_probe.log). The WSL virtual disk can only grow (no sparse mode in .wslconfig), so a recovery of C: space must come from the Windows side; the cause is not identifiable from inside WSL.
investigation_2026_11_12.vhdx_slack_note: the virtual disk (ext4.vhdx, 80.0 GB on C:) holds ~24 GB more than Linux uses; fstrim (needs sudo) plus enabling sparse mode or compacting the vhdx from Windows would return it to C:
investigation_2026_11_12.fstrim: not run: `sudo fstrim -v /` needs Stanley's password (sudo -n fails)
investigation_2026_11_12.cache_note: deleting them frees space inside the vhdx only; C: gains nothing without fstrim + sparse/compaction, so nothing was deleted
investigation_2026_11_12.streaming_guard: the HVFHV streaming script checks C: free space before each month and stops below 15 GB (Amendment 4)
